title: Cloud store for Chatticus per-bot boards (kanbus-api as a deployable multi-board service)
description: Ryan decided 2026-10-20: Kanbus owns the cloud issue store (virtuus-store + services/kanbus-api); Chatticus deploys Kanbus-shipped kanbus-api in its own AWS account, one per environment (development, staging, production), called from Chatticus's TypeScript control plane, building on Preview starting in development. Mapping under discussion: tenant = Chatticus organization id, project = bot id (one internal board per bot). Today the shipped Lambda (services/kanbus-api/src/bin/lambda.rs) binds one KANBUS_NAMESPACE (one tenant/project) and one Cognito group per deployment; the library's with_projects allowlist caps at MAX_PROJECTS = 8 (lib.rs:25), a Preview query fan-out budget for multi-project list queries. The S3 key layout and the DynamoDB catalog (PK scope = tenant/project) already support any number of scopes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-20, via the Chatticus session): one Kanbus project per bot. tenant = Chatticus organization id, project = bot id, bucket and catalog table per environment (development, staging, production). Chatticus is writing its bot-board Gherkin specs against this model and will not build against kanbus-api until kbs-9cb5cb40, kbs-4818904b, kbs-f222b6ee and kbs-a19d1443 land. Any change to routes, auth or scope naming must be announced to the Chatticus session before it ships.
